title: Majority Fourier weight convergence and monotonicity
statement: For each odd positive integer $k$, let $W_k(r)$ be the sum of the squared level-$k$ Fourier coefficients of majority on the cube $\\{-1,1\\}^{k+2r}$, with Fourier coefficients taken as expectations under the uniform measure. Then $W_k(r)$ is strictly decreasing in $r$ and converges, as $r\to\infty$, to $\frac{2}{\pi}a_k$, where $a_k=\frac{2}{k2^k}\binom{k-1}{(k-1)/2}$.
